senses.gloss: , f. (גָּזַז) shearing; wool cut or to be cut.
units: <cite ref="Bekhorot 14a">Bekh. 14ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bekhorot 25a:9">25ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 135a:11">Ḥull. 135ᵃ</cite> <he>אסורים בג׳</he> must not be shorn.
<cite ref="Chullin 135a:9">Ib.</cite> <he>בני ג׳</he> permitted to be cut.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 19:1:8">Y. Sabb. XIX, 17ᵃ</cite> top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 6:1:5">Y. Pes. VI, 33ᵃ</cite> (<he>בגִיזָּתָהּ</he>) <he>בגִיזָּתוֹ</he> between its wool (Bab.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 1:13">Midr. Till. to Ps. I</cite> <he>זמן ג׳</he>, v. <cite ref="C00545"><he>גְּזִיזָה</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>גִּיזּוֹת</he>, <he>גִּיזּוֹת</he>. Ḥull. l. c. <he>חוץ מגִּיזּוֹתֶיהָ</he> with the exception of its wool. Midr. Till. l. c. <he>ללבוש מגִּזּוֹתֵיהֶן</he> to have garments from their wool.
